title: Complete activity and question lifecycle migration
summary: Validate server-owned activities, once-only question settlement and continuation through exchanges, visits, rewards, battles, level-ups, teleport movement and save/load. Real-server tests cover malformed, wrong-player, duplicate, stale and covered replies.
preparation: Use the Thor companion to verify and install this exact candidate while preserving data. Keep a pre-migration save. Prepare meeting heroes, a Town visitor, a reward object that grants experience and creatures, a neutral battle and a teleport route. Use disposable saves for rewards and replay.
limitations: Mark unavailable scenarios Blocked with notes. Forged packets and shared-stack interleavings are automated server tests. Activity continuations are runtime-only: saves must wait until interactions settle; a standalone game pause remains saveable. CI/device acceptance does not authorize merging.

checks.title: Hero Meeting, Town and allied exchange
checks.steps: Transfer, split, merge and redistribute units and move artifacts on upper and lower screens in a Meeting and Town visitor exchange. Close/reopen; try rapid actions. If multiplayer is available, open an allied exchange, let the partner donate their own units/artifacts and hold an artifact while the initiator closes. Try an ally already in a dialog and hotseat.
checks.expected: Transfers preserve units and locks. Only the initiator closes; the partner window and children close on server settlement, with held artifacts returned and no pending lower controls. Busy/hotseat allies are not stranded.

checks.title: Nested visits, reward choices and turn start
checks.steps: Choose and cancel object dialogs. Claim a reward granting multiple hero/commander levels and more creatures than fit. Resolve the level-ups and garrison window; where available, claim consecutive Seer Hut rewards. With turn timers enabled, start a turn in a Town containing a reward building.
checks.expected: Each chosen reward applies once. Hero levels precede commander levels; remaining rewards and building visits resume after their children. Turn events and visits wait behind turn acceptance. Dialogs never strand the turn.

checks.title: Battle result, replay and teleport continuation
checks.steps: Finish a neutral battle that causes a level-up, dismiss the result and choose skills; exercise replay in a disposable save. Stop/continue an upper/lower route through a guard and a teleport. Dismiss any nested messages before proceeding; try rapid accept/cancel.
checks.expected: Battle/reward effects apply once, level-ups precede object continuation, and the ordinary Adventure view returns. Teleport movement continues only after its own question actually resolves; rejected or older answers do not restart a route.

checks.title: Existing saves and settled new saves
checks.steps: Load a pre-migration save, finish a reward or battle, save after dialogs close and reload. Repeat from a standalone game pause. Attempt saving during a pending turn-start acceptance or interaction, then accept/finish and save again.
checks.expected: Existing saves and new settled saves retain creatures, armies, rewards, heroes and turn state. Unserialized continuations cannot be lost through a mid-interaction save. Saving works once pending work is settled and during a standalone pause.

checks.title: Display, modal restoration and input regressions
checks.steps: While Meeting, reward, level-up and battle-result windows are open, toggle/reconnect the lower display and background/resume. Close each via upper touch/controller, check the restored parent and current lower controls, then repeat with one display.
checks.expected: Correct native parent and lower context return without a residual battle frame, stale hit regions, duplicate actions or stuck input. Upper touch/controller and single-display play remain usable.
